archetypes.name: migration-parity
archetypes.rationale: The commit ports several shell contracts only partially and needs parity scrutiny.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new Python helper entrypoints against the historical shell helper contracts. Focus on argument order, stdout KV compatibility, exit codes, and cases where wrappers now pass subcommands through python/cli.py. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: callsite-routing
archetypes.rationale: Many shell and skill call sites changed from script paths to Python CLI verbs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the modified /implement and /design call sites end to end. Check for invalid argv ordering, quoted array mistakes, missing accepted options, and any remaining stale helper path that is still live. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: lint-readiness
archetypes.rationale: py-lint currently reports style findings in the new modules.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the migration modules for lint and maintainability issues that could block CI. Prioritize low-risk fixes that preserve the newly added pytest coverage and CLI behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
